mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the collecting duct was most worthwhile because the result explained how its permeability and the medullary gradient work together to recover water.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the loop and vessels to the renal unit felt least worthwhile: the result confirmed the assembly but added no explanation.

surprise.text: The distinction between the loop establishing the gradient and the vessels preserving it changed my understanding, although I still wanted to know how they do those things.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, but connecting the loop assembly to the renal unit was a predictable construction step with little explanatory payoff.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see how the regulated kidney responds to a drink, though I would want more explanation of the underlying mechanisms.
